profile.headline: Software Engineer · Application Security, Cloud & DevOps
profile.summary: Software engineer with 8+ years of production experience, now focused on application security, cloud, and DevOps. I've built React, TypeScript, and Node.js applications on AWS and GCP, added static analysis, test, and coverage gates to CI/CD pipelines, and found and fixed an OAuth implicit-flow weakness in a multi-state GovTech platform by moving it to authorization code with PKCE.

positions.title: Freelance Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Architected and shipped a fan engagement map for the NY Knicks, a React/Leaflet app with a Firebase backend, featured on nba.com/knicks/new-york-hoops.
• Engineered a serverless content moderation pipeline using Google Cloud Functions and Firestore triggers, automatically routing submitted content to reviewers through a one-click accept/reject workflow.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · TypeScript · Firebase · Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

positions.title: Low Voltage Technician
positions.description:
• Deployed Layer 1-3 network infrastructure for new commercial installs, terminating Category 5/5e/6 copper cabling and diagnosing connectivity faults with Fluke cable testers and tone probes.

• Performed VLAN and switch port configuration during new-site builds, partnering with remote network engineers over terminal sessions on deeper switch-level troubleshooting.

 • Configured wireless access points and IP cameras through vendor controllers, handling SSID setup, static IP assignment, and endpoint connectivity.
positions.insights: Skills: Local Area Network (LAN) · Structured Cabling · Network Design · Cat5e · Troubleshooting · Network Installation · Technical Requirements · Network Infrastructure

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Replaced keycloak-js with react-oidc-context, a standard OIDC client library, redesigning authentication and session handling and strengthening access-control enforcement across a multi-state GovTech platform.

• Integrated automated testing, linting, and code coverage reporting into GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, enforcing pass/fail checks on every pull request.

• Implemented cross-tab session management in React, synchronizing idle-timeout and logout state across concurrent browser sessions to prevent stale token reuse after sign-out.

• Drove TypeScript adoption across frontend codebases using JSDoc annotations and generated type definitions, introducing compile-time type safety to previously untyped code.

projects.title: DevSecOps CI/CD Pipeline
projects.description: Built a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline integrating Semgrep, Trivy, Gitleaks, and OWASP ZAP, with severity-based build failure enforcement across the deployment lifecycle.

projects.title: Wazuh SIEM Home Lab
projects.description: Deployed Wazuh SIEM/XDR in a Docker-based home lab, configuring multi-agent monitoring across Ubuntu and macOS endpoints with real-time log ingestion, FIM, and vulnerability detection. Simulated SSH brute force and lateral movement techniques, authored custom Wazuh detection rules, and validated alert accuracy against MITRE ATT&CK, confirming end-to-end threat detection coverage.
